attributes.title: Level 6

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about how you can create custom sprite assets using a specific color palette to build a sprite pack with a unified theme!

questions.hint: Which other sprite(s) fit a space-themed sprite pack?
questions.title: [Select all that apply] Select all of the sprites that might be found in a space-themed sprite pack:
questions.correctResponse: Sprite packs include a collection of sprites of different kinds that often have a unified theme and color palette.

questions.hint: What does matching the sprite’s image to their direction accomplish in a project?
questions.title: [Select one] Why is it most useful to create sprite images that match the direction it’s facing in a project?

answers.text: It keeps the user on their toes
It makes the project more realistic
It’s fun to use different images

questions.correctResponse: When designing projects, it’s important that the assets used replicate lifelike actions. In real life, if a person turns, you should only be able to see a certain side of them. As a result, different images should be used to show this in projects!

questions.title: [Open response] What types of image assets will you include in your project’s sprite pack?
questions.correctResponse: Those sound like great ideas! Looking forward to seeing what you create in your custom sprite pack!

subgroups.title: Custom Sprite Packs
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about how you can create custom sprite assets using a specific color palette to build a sprite pack with a unified theme!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 6 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating images that show multiple perspectives of the same sprite and themed sprite packs for projects. You’ll be able to take the strategies you learn in this level to create detailed assets in future projects! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 6:

badges.title: Package Deal
badges.description: Create a sprite pack that includes different sprite kinds and different perspectives of those sprites, to be used in a project.

badges.title: Covering All My Bases
badges.description: Create pixel art images that show multiple points of view for a sprite: forward, backward, left, and right.

badges.title: Group by Theme
badges.description: Use a specific color palette and theme to create a sprite pack of different sprite kinds.

badges.title: The Gang’s All Here!
badges.description: Create a sprite pack of original pixel art images that includes Player, Collectible, Goal, Enemy, and Projectile sprites.
